description: This source file defines the class `Chart_pipeline_by_sales_stage` which generates a pipeline report chart based on sales stages within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for drawing the chart, generating XML data for the chart, and constructing database queries. The file integrates with SuiteCRM's permission, user preference, and database systems, and it handles user input for date ranges, sales stages, and user selection to customize the report output.

classes.name: Chart_pipeline_by_sales_stage
classes.description: A class that produces a pipeline report chart based on sales stages for Opportunities, integrating with SuiteCRM's framework.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the pipeline chart, handles user preferences, and displays the chart with options to refresh or edit the details.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Generates the XML data for the chart by querying Opportunity data filtered by sales stages, user, and date range, and caches the result.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds a SQL query string to fetch opportunity data based on user preferences and request parameters.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns grouping fields used in the data query.
